source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of stack properties (PDF 95-96).

items: LIFO principle (usool): stack Last-In, First-Out rule (qaida) par chalta hai. Jo item aakhir mein dala, woh pehle nikalta hai.
Single access point (ek hi rasta): items sirf stack ke top se dale aur nikale ja sakte hain.
Order preservation (order qaim rehna): items jis order (tarteeb) se dale gaye woh order yaad rehta hai, aur aakhri item sab se pehle bahar aata hai.
Size flexibility (size mein lachak): stack ka size fixed (pehle se tay) bhi ho sakta hai aur zaroorat ke hisab se barh bhi sakta hai.

blocks.text: Sequential access (baari baari pohanch): items tak sirf usi order mein pohancha ja sakta hai jis mein woh dale gaye, top se shuru kar ke.

blocks.prompt: Stack se beech wali kitab seedhe kyun nahi nikal sakte?
blocks.explanation: Stack ka ek hi rasta hai, top. Beech wali kitab tak pohanchne ke liye pehle us ke oopar wali kitabein pop karni hongi.

items: Stack ki properties: LIFO, ek hi rasta (top), order qaim, fixed ya barhne wala size, top se baari baari pohanch.
